HTTP and MCP Boundary
|-- Composition root: src/server/app/bootstrap.ts -> createBackend(...)
|   |-- Chooses concrete stores, runtimes and application services
|   |   |-- DiagramStore + file-backed workspace, context, chat, change and eval stores
|   |   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT=fake selects fake chat, mapping, edit, compaction and eval runtimes
|   |   `-- piEnabled configures AI integrations; lspEnabled creates ProjectLanguageService
|   |-- Shared canvas machinery
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge wraps CanvasSessionBridge
|   |   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService uses bridge, changes, contexts and QuickJsAgentRuntime
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService reads canvas context through the same bridge
|   |   `-- AgentChatService uses live canvas, diagram tools, MCP binding and context library
|   |-- Connects generation, persistence, proposals and evaluation
|   |   |-- PushIntegrationService -> DiffSessionWorkflowService -> changes + agent
|   |   |-- Workspace + generated canvas catalog -> comparison sessions
|   |   `-- Eval runs share chat generation records, output snapshots and comparison services
|   `-- Returns core/mapping routes, liveCanvas and dispose()
|       `-- Vite HTTP server close -> dispose sockets, services, bridges and runtimes
|-- HTTP entry: src/server/app/vitePlugin.ts -> diagramApi(...)
|   |-- Installs the same middleware in Vite development and preview servers
|   |-- Request dispatch
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |   |-- /api/core/... -> createCoreRoutes
|   |   |-- /api/mapping/... -> createMappingRoutes
|   |   `-- Other intercepted paths, including /internal/... -> 404
|   |-- Programmable tool write gate: src/server/http/apiAccess.ts
|   |   |-- Applies only to /api/mapping/agent/tools/...
|   |   |-- GET, HEAD, OPTIONS bypass mutation classification
|   |   |-- POST read exceptions
|   |   |   |-- list_repositories, get_repository_diff_hunks, read_change_session_diff_tree
|   |   |   `-- edit-diagram-status, diagram-search, canvas-api-search
|   |   `-- Other tool requests require httpEnabled=true or a chat-binding header
|   |       |-- Otherwise -> 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |       `-- App persistence/sync routes remain available; bound calls resolve in the service
|   `-- Transport helpers: src/server/http/http.ts
|       |-- readBody -> UTF-8 JSON; empty body becomes {}; invalid JSON throws
|       |-- Default body limit: 10 MiB
|       |   |-- Workspace saves/batches/export/import-contexts and canvas replies: 64 MiB
|       |   `-- Oversize body -> reject while draining the remaining request
|       |-- sendJson -> status + application/json + response end
|       |-- sendEvent -> one JSON record followed by LF
|       `-- Uncaught route failure -> Vite error translation
|           |-- Before headers: 413 size, 409 conflict, 415 binary source,
|           |   503 disabled/unavailable services, otherwise 400
|           `-- After headers: write an error record, then end if still writable
|-- HTTP application surface: src/server/routes/{core,mapping}/...
|   |-- /api/core/project -> source and catalog services [source]
|   |   |-- GET files/source -> ProjectSourceService
|   |   |-- POST definitions -> enabled language lookup; response close aborts lookup
|   |   `-- Projections, corpus-compactions and representations -> catalog/CoreApplication
|   |-- /api/mapping/agent -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService [live-agent, changes]
|   |   |-- POST tools/{name}, if registered in agentToolSchemas
|   |   |   |-- String x-canvas-chat-binding -> service.callBound(token, name, input)
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise -> service.call(name, input)
|   |   |-- Browser contracts: attachments, diagram-edits, cancel and proposal acceptance
|   |   |   `-- Attachment route constructs canvas.attach code from validated IDs
|   |   |-- Change sessions: list/read, versioned preview and treemaps, accept
|   |   |-- Canvas command bridge
|   |   |   |-- GET/POST canvases -> list/register; DELETE canvases/{id} -> unregister
|   |   |   |-- GET canvases/{id}/commands -> poll commands
|   |   |   `-- POST canvases/{id}/reply -> deliver command result/error
|   |   |       `-- Oversize reply with command header -> notify bridge of rejection + HTTP 413
|   |   `-- Local error mapping: version/request-ID/content-hash conflicts -> 409;
|   |       unavailable -> 503; oversized -> 413; other failures -> 400
|   |-- Workspace and diagrams [persistence]
|   |   |-- GET/PUT workspace -> load/save
|   |   |-- GET/POST workspace/records -> load records/apply batch
|   |   |-- POST workspace/export or import-contexts -> portable export/prepare import
|   |   `-- POST diagrams or diagrams/publish -> save/publish checkpoint; DELETE diagram -> delete
|   |-- Chat and generation [generation]
|   |   |-- /chat -> LocalChatService; /compactions -> FileCompactionService
|   |   |-- POST /prompt -> SelectionService.prepare -> run -> streamed progress/result
|   |   `-- /agent-chat -> AgentChatService
|   |       |-- Sessions: create/list/read/resume; send/read-canvas/reload-tools/interrupt/answer
|   |       |-- Generation: list, gen-alternatives and cancel-generation
|   |       |-- GET tools -> definitions for binding; POST tools/{name} -> callBoundTool
|   |       |   `-- Requires callId; MCP origin comes from the actual local listening port
|   |       `-- Public sessions/events omit tool definitions, generation requests and history
|   |-- Change intake [changes]
|   |   |-- /workflows/diff-session-create... -> DiffSessionWorkflowService handler
|   |   `-- /integrations/... -> PushIntegrationService handler with configured push token
|   `-- Evaluation and comparison [evals]
|       |-- /evals/prompts, prompt-snapshots, references, reference-groups -> evidence/configuration
|       |-- /evals/runs and roll-ups -> start asynchronously with HTTP 202; read/cancel/manage runs
|       |-- /evals/reference-sessions -> open, load sources, generate
|       |-- /evals/experiments, judgements, layout-templates, histories -> supporting workflows
|       |-- /evals/... -> capture, output results, promotion and generated canvas access
|       |-- /compare-sessions and /comparison-runs -> comparison handlers
|       `-- /generated-canvases -> list generated canvases or migrate through EvalRunService
|-- Streaming and live transport
|   |-- Selection response: POST /api/mapping/prompt
|   |   `-- application/x-ndjson -> progress records -> result record -> end
|   |-- Chat events: GET /api/mapping/agent-chat/sessions/{id}/events
|   |   |-- text/event-stream; identity encoding; flush headers; heartbeat every 15 seconds
|   |   |-- Subscribe -> public snapshot and subsequent chat events
|   |   |   |-- Large completed tool details are shortened; full items remain separately readable
|   |   |   `-- Multi-item snapshot -> partial header + one item per snapshot-part + final flag
|   |   |-- Snapshot gets its own drain allowance; extra backlog over 2 MiB destroys response
|   |   `-- Response close -> clear heartbeat and unsubscribe
|   |-- Live HTTP reads: /api/mapping/live
|   |   |-- GET context/short -> workspace/document context + epoch/version headers; no-store
|   |   `-- GET connections/{id}/selection -> selection + sequence/version/time headers
|   |       `-- ETag matches If-None-Match -> 304
|   `-- WebSocket upgrade: /api/mapping/live -> LiveCanvasService
|       |-- Origin absent or same host required; at most 1024 clients
|       |-- JSON text frames; 8 MiB inbound limit; schema validation
|       |-- First frame binds one role
|       |   |-- attach -> external reader for workspace/document -> attached event
|       |   |   |-- Optional initial context; context.get fetches later snapshots
|       |   |   `-- Reader can request copy/paste or upload agent context when enabled
|       |   `-- publish -> browser publisher -> publisher.ready, protocolVersion 2
|       |       `-- Publishes selection updates/removals and handles copy/paste replies
|       |-- httpEnabled controls copy/paste and agent-context upload permissions
|       |-- Attach timeout: 10 seconds; initial context wait: 30 seconds
|       |-- Backpressure: queue over 64 KiB plus context allowance -> close 1013
|       |   |-- Reconnect for an authoritative snapshot; deltas are not dropped individually
|       |   `-- Context payload over 64 MiB -> close 1009
|       `-- Ping every 15 seconds; missed pong terminates socket
|           `-- Close -> detach reader or disconnect publisher; server close removes upgrade listener
`-- MCP adapter: infrastructure/mapping/mcp/server.ts -> the same HTTP services
    |-- Startup: scripts/mapping/mcp.ts
    |   |-- Backend URL from first argument or MAPPING_URL; requires HTTP(S)
    |   |-- Optional --canvas/--document or environment IDs; both IDs required together
    |   `-- startMappingMcpServer -> register tools -> StdioServerTransport
    |-- Agent tools: names and schemas from agentToolSchemas
    |   |-- Tool call -> POST /api/mapping/agent/tools/{name}
    |   |   `-- JSON body, optional x-canvas-chat-binding, 65-second timeout
    |   |-- Connection scope
    |   |   |-- Unbound -> caller lists/attaches canvas and supplies sessionId
    |   |   |-- Explicit target without chat binding -> lazy canvas.attach via exec
    |   |   |   |-- Cache attachment promise; failure clears cache for retry
    |   |   |   `-- Inject sessionId into selected canvas tools; reject mismatched sessionId
    |   |   |       `-- Proposal calls and representation-specific searches bypass auto-attachment
    |   |   `-- Chat binding -> optional sessionId; backend resolves the bound call
    |   |-- Diagram tools adapt single/batch schemas; unbound calls receive final schema validation
    |   `-- Instructions tell callers to reuse identical arguments/requestId for uncertain retries
    |-- Additional HTTP-backed tools
    |   |-- generate-roll-up -> POST /api/mapping/evals/roll-ups
    |   |-- read-eval-run -> GET /api/mapping/evals/runs/{runId}
    |   |-- generate/read-diagram-comparison-run -> POST/GET /api/mapping/comparison-runs[/id]
    |   `-- list-compare-candidates -> GET /api/mapping/compare-sessions/candidates
    |-- Bound chat tools: registerChatMcpTools
    |   |-- Fetch current definitions from GET /api/mapping/agent-chat/tools
    |   |-- Convert JSON schemas to object schemas; register chat_{name}
    |   `-- Call -> POST /api/mapping/agent-chat/tools/{name}
    |       `-- Forward binding + {input, callId: mcp:<MCP request ID>}
    `-- HTTP result -> MCP text containing JSON
        |-- HTTP success -> also structuredContent: {result}
        `-- HTTP failure or exception -> isError: true
